test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In a class of 45 students, the average age of the class is 18 years. The average age of 35 students is 15. What is the average age of the remaining 10 students?
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 45 students = 18 years

Average of 35 students = 15 years

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of ages of all students) / (Number of students)

**Calculation:**

The average age of 45 students = 18

⇒ Sum of ages of 45 students = 45 × 18 = 810

The average age of 35 students = 15

⇒ Sum of ages of 35 students = 35 × 15 = 525

Sum of ages of remaining 10 students = 810 - 525

⇒ Sum of ages of remaining 10 students = 285

Average age of remaining 10 students = 285/10

⇒ Average age of remaining 10 students = 28.5

**∴ The average**** age of the remaining 10 students is 28.5.**
